fields.schemeName: Janani Sahayogi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free and safe delivery and newborn care services to BPL families by offering free treatment to pregnant women in government and accredited private hospitals.

fields.schemeName: Seed Program
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free vegetable seeds to small and marginal farmers and agricultural laborers living below the poverty line.

fields.schemeName: Manav Garima Yojna (NT DNT)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enable nomadic and de-notified castes to live with dignity and become self-employed. Through this scheme, business tool-kits are provided to these beneficiaries to help them start small businesses and achieve financial self-sufficiency.

fields.schemeName: Infrastructure Development Scheme for Dairy Co-operatives
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Dairy Co-operative Societies for their development, smooth functioning of business, and other allied activities, enabling them to become stable and create better infrastructure. The scheme provides financial support in the form of grant or subsidy.

fields.schemeName: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Quality
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support environmentally sustainable industrial development while accelerating investment in Goa. The scheme provides a one-time reimbursement equal to 50% of the expenses incurred for establishing a Quality Management System, capped at ₹5,00,000/- per Entity.

fields.schemeName: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Skill Development
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides reimbursement of 50% of the cost incurred for skill upgradation and training manpower, limited to a maximum of ₹5,000/- per person employed in the Entity. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC).

fields.schemeName: Procurement of Food Grains From Farmers at Support Price
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure fair and assured prices for farmers by enabling direct government procurement of wheat, paddy, maize, and jowar from registered farmers at the centrally declared Minimum Support Price (MSP) along with any applicable state bonus during the designated procurement period.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Promote Mechanization for the Development of Horticulture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote mechanization for the development of horticulture by providing subsidies to farmers for purchasing modern agricultural machinery used in horticultural crops.

fields.schemeName: National AIDS Control Programme - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The programme aims to prevent and control the spread of HIV/AIDS through awareness, testing, and treatment, while providing care and support to affected individuals.

fields.schemeName: Lab on Wheels
fields.briefDescription: This program has been launched to promote & popularize science education among school students and youth studying science subjects across all 13 districts of Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Atal Kisan Jyoti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide affordable electricity to farmers in Madhya Pradesh by offering power supply at concessional rates.

fields.schemeName: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar’s Electric Auto (e-Auto) Subsidy Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to socially and economically empower Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe women by supporting them in income-generating activities through electric autos. It provides a subsidy up to 75% of the cost (maximum ₹3,00,000/-) for electric autos to Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe women.

fields.schemeName: Bal Swasthya Karyakram - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: This initiative aims to ensure the survival, healthy growth, and overall well-being of children aged 0–5 years by providing accessible, comprehensive and quality healthcare services.

fields.schemeName: Balram Talab Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to conserve rainwater in fields to help farmers, ensuring water availability during irrigation and drought conditions. Farmers receive subsidies up to ₹1,00,000/- for pond construction.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Goa Rajya Vidnyanik Puraskar
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to introduce and recognize Goan Innovators/Scientists who have achieved excellence in the fields of Science, Technology, and Innovation. The scheme rewards eligible Students, Startups, Innovators, Research Faculty, and Scientists with three annual cash awards of ₹2,00,000/- each.

fields.schemeName: Scheme To Support Orphan Child/Children Of Widows Belonging To Scheduled Tribe Community
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide crucial financial support for food, clothing, and shelter to children of widows and orphans belonging to the ST community Benefits include a monthly fixed maintenance allowance of ₹1,500/- for a widow’s child or ₹2,000/- for an orphan.

fields.schemeName: Aromatic Plants Cultivation - Centre for Aromatic Plants
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage farmers to grow aromatic plants by providing them with free seeds, planting materials, and technical support, helping them increase their income and promote aromatic farming in Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Tribals Development Plan: Tea/Coffee And Coconut Parlor
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to attract tourists with better quality mechanized Tea and Coffee shops and tender coconut water parlors, as Goa is a tourist destination, ensuring better hygiene than other restaurants. The scheme provides entire project financing for establishing a parlor.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Encourage Students for Innovative Projects
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage students in the State of Goa who have technological innovative ideas, which they want to translate into a working prototype, by providing financial assistance. It offers financial support of up to ₹50,000/- to eligible students for innovative academic projects.

fields.schemeName: Goa State 25% Subsidy for Self Employed Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost self-employment in Goa and subsidize Capital Investment to encourage the creation of fixed assets. The scheme provides a 25% subsidy on fixed capital investment to individuals, partnership firms, or groups of individuals who have availed loans for approved self-employment.

fields.schemeName: Government Food Science Training Centre
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide specialized education and skill development in food processing, canning, bakery, confectionery, and cookery to students from Uttarakhand, empowering them with technical knowledge and practical expertise to pursue careers in the food industry and promote entrepreneurship.

fields.schemeName: Dairy Equipment Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help Goan dairy farmers purchase essential equipment by offering a 75% subsidy on approved dairy machinery, promoting efficiency and productivity in dairy farming.

fields.schemeName: Laptop-e Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to equip Class XI students with individual portable computer systems to enhance digital learning, knowledge acquisition, and skill attainment for employment or self-employment. Students receive one entry-level Laptop or Notebook equipped with specific technical requirements.

fields.schemeName: Solar Water Heater Yojana - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the use of solar energy for water heating in the state to reduce dependence on conventional electricity and fossil fuels, and to encourage the adoption of green and sustainable energy sources in Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Swahid Dayal Das Panika Swaniyojan Achoni
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the self-employed youths belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community in Assam to encourage and initiate self-employment activities. The benefit is financial support for self-employed youth to enhance their capabilities.

fields.schemeName: Grant to Films
fields.briefDescription: The policy aims to promote film production in Uttarakhand by providing financial grants to films, TV serials, and web series shot in the state, encouraging filmmakers to showcase Uttarakhand’s culture, heritage, and locations, and boosting local employment and the state's film economy.

fields.schemeName: Awareness Programme on Child/Human Trafficking, Family Planning, Legal Awareness, Health etc.
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to generate awareness among the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community regarding child/human trafficking, family planning, legal awareness, and health. It generates awareness benefits for the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community through Non-Governmental Organizations proposals.

fields.schemeName: Map Approval through UDAY App
fields.briefDescription: It aims to simplify and expedite the process of residential property map creation and approval for all landowners in Haridwar district through mobile app.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Acquisition of Electro-Medical and Other Equipment (PIPDIC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to financially assist the registered Medical practitioners for acquisition and installation of Electro Medical and other related equipment. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

fields.schemeName: Computer Training Scheme for Visually Impaired Persons
fields.briefDescription: The scheme helps visually impaired individuals by giving them computer and screen-reading training and providing a laptop to the beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Assistance to Good Borrowers: ‘B’ Category
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support and reward existing industrial units and transport loanees who have maintained a satisfactory repayment track record. It provides term loans ranging from ₹5,00,000/- to ₹150,00,000/- for expansion, modernization, or acquisition of fixed assets.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Tourism-related Activities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to financially assist entrepreneurs for setting up or development of amusement parks, cultural centres, convention centres, restaurants, tourist service agencies, including expansion and modernization project. The applications for scheme are accepted online through PIPDIC portal.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Hospitals / Nursing Homes (PIPDIC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to financially assist the entrepreneurs for setting up hospitals/nursing homes. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

fields.schemeName: Kisan Credit Card Scheme for Fisheries- Chief Minister Fishermen Prosperity Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide short-term loans for fisheries. It offers zero-percent interest working capital to the fish farmers through cooperative banks.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kalyani Vivah Sahayta Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widowed women during remarriage. It offers a one-time support of ₹2,00,000 to eligible kalyani beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Teelu Rauteli Pension Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,200/- to male and female individuals above 18 years of age who have incurred a partial disability of 20% to 40% while performing agricultural activities.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship to Divyang Students (Class 1 to 8)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹600/- for students in Class 1 to 5 and ₹960/- for students in Class 6 to 8, to regularly enrolled disable students.

fields.schemeName: Procedure for Admission in Government Child Care Institution, Government Communication Home and Open Shelter Home
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support orphaned, destitute, abandoned & vulnerable children by providing them with clothing, food, accommodation, medical care, education & other essential facilities in Government Child Care Institutions, Government Communication Homes, & Open Shelter Homes within the state.

fields.schemeName: Pension Scheme for Elderly, Destitute Artists, Litterateurs and Writers of Uttarakhand State
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to elderly and impoverished artists, litterateurs and writers who have dedicated their lives to the development of art, culture, and literature and have made significant and distinguished contributions.

fields.schemeName: Nandaa Gaura Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for upto 2 girls in a family. Assistance is given in 2 installments per girl child: 1st installment of ₹11,000 is provided at the time of birth if girl is born in a hospital/ANM center & 2nd installment of ₹51,000 is given when girl passes Class 12th.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Authors for Book Publication
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the state's eminent litterateurs, writers, poets, and authors by providing financial assistance whose literary works remain unpublished due to financial constraints.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Bal Poshan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the health of pre-school children (aged 3 to 6 years) by providing nutritious food, including eggs twice a week and banana chips twice a week, at Anganwadi Centres.

fields.schemeName: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among persons with disabilities through grants, term loans, and margin money assistance.

fields.schemeName: Award Scheme for Candidates Selected in NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, IAF
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a one-time award of ₹50,000/- is given to each candidate from Uttarakhand who has been selected for service at premier defence academies such as the NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, and IAF.

fields.schemeName: Organization of Multi-Purpose Camps/ Public Awareness Camps/ Medical Camps/Legal Service Camps
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to organize camps & awareness programs across urban & rural areas to inform and empower vulnerable groups such as women, children, senior citizens, workers in the unorganized sector, persons with disabilities, acid attack survivors & victims of trafficking about their legal rights.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kaushal Unnayan and Vaishvik Rojgar Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide skill upgradation training along with country-specific training to the youth of the state, enabling them to secure employment opportunities abroad.

fields.schemeName: Operation/implementation of Vidhik Seva Rath
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to spread legal awareness and provide information about welfare schemes to people in both urban and remote rural areas, ensuring that citizens are informed about their rights and available government benefits.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship to Poor Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate programs at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University.

fields.schemeName: Uttarakhand Compensation Scheme for Women Victims/Survivors of Sexual Offences and Other Crimes, 2020
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance/compensation ranging from a minimum of ₹3 lakh to a maximum of ₹10 lakh to women victims and survivors of sexual offences, as well as to other women victims of crime in the state.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Dhyanpal Singh Memorial Award (for Final-Year Undergraduate Students of All Colleges)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support and encourage meritorious students by providing them with monetary assistance of ₹30,000/- in their final year of undergraduate studies, thereby reducing financial burdens.
